cons: 摘要未充分说明跨模型泛化、长周期稳定性与存储/一致性开销，严谨性证据偏弱

papers.title_zh: KVUse：可重用的 KV 用户内存，用于高效的 LLM 推荐器
papers.summary_zh: 基于大型语言模型 (LLM) 的记忆增强推荐系统维护每个用户的自然语言配置文件。这些配置文件由用户配置文件更新路径进行更新，该路径会在新交互到达时修改配置文件，并被下游任务路径（例如排名）消耗。由于这些用户配置文件以文本形式存储在用户内存中，因此使用它们的每个排名 LLM 调用都必须将它们拼接在提示中，并在预填充阶段计算它们的 KV 缓存。鉴于这些排名 LLM 调用的预填充量很大（长提示但短解码输出）并且重复调用，这些重复的用户配置文件文本预填充在服务中占主导地位。前缀缓存无法删除它，因为这些用户配置文件在不同的调用中前面有不同的文本。我们提出了 KVUse，它将用户配置文件存储为可重用的键值 (KV) 缓存而不是文本。 KVUse 通过自蒸馏来训练轻量级 LoRA 编写器，以便用户配置文件更新调用在解码时生成用户配置文件的可重用 KV，并且 LLM 可以在新位置和新上下文后面读取这些可重用 KV，而无需重新计算。 KVUse 还有一个定制的 KV 调度程序，可以在计算当前批次时上传下一批存储的可重用 KV，从而将主机内存中的 KV 传输隐藏在 GPU 计算后面。在使用 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 的四个 InstructRec 数据集上，KVUse 显示在连续内存更新轮次中完全预填充的排名质量没有统计学上的显着差异。在饱和负载下，KVUse 将下游评分路径的吞吐量提高了 4.0x-4.5x，将配置文件更新路径的吞吐量提高了 1.4x-1.9x。

papers.title: VisHead-Spec: Head-Routed Visual Attention for Multimodal Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: Speculative decoding accelerates vision-language models(VLMs) while preserving the target model's outputs, but its speedup diminishes under high concurrency serving as the system becomes more compute bounded as the batch size increases. This problem is pronounced for multimodal speculative decoding as the long range of the image tokens in the prompt can significantly increase the computational cost during draft token prediction. The block-diffusion drafters (e.g. DFlash, DSpark) can effectively speed up the draft model efficiency by predicting multiple draft tokens in one forward pass, but their speedup for VLMs under high concurrency is still modest (<9%). In order to understand this gap, we examine the information flow between different modalities from target model to draft model and identify the sparsity pattern of visual attention between the target and draft models: only small set of key-value heads in the draft model need direct visual feature attention in the context and only visual features from top level layers in the target model need to be attended in the context. We therefore propose VisHead-Spec, which selects a small, fixed set of key-value (KV) heads to attend to all image features from top level layers in the target model and restricts the remaining heads to text features. On Qwen3-VL-8B and MMSpec, VisHead-Spec-8 lets 8 of the drafter's 40 KV heads read the image while keeping accepted length within 0.3% of the block-diffusion draft model baseline (i.e. DSpark). At batch size 64, its throughput gain over autoregressive decoding increases to 16.0%, compared with 9.5% for DSpark; at batch size 1, its speedup remains comparable to DSpark.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，但证据广度与外推性不足。
pros: 聚焦高并发下VLM推理解码加速瓶颈，问题设定有实际价值
利用跨模态注意力稀疏性做头级路由，思路简洁且工程可落地
cons: 实验覆盖面偏窄（模型/数据/场景有限），对不同架构与任务的泛化性尚未充分验证
吞吐提升幅度相对有限，缺少更细的代价拆解与误差-速度权衡分析

papers.title_zh: VisHead-Spec：用于多模态推测解码的头部路由视觉注意
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码可加速视觉语言模型 (VLM)，同时保留目标模型的输出，但在高并发情况下，其加速会减弱，因为随着批量大小的增加，系统变得更加受计算限制。这个问题对于多模态推测解码来说很明显，因为提示中图像标记的长范围会显着增加草稿标记预测期间的计算成本。块扩散起草器（例如 DFlash、DSpark）可以通过在一次前向传递中预测多个草稿令牌来有效地加快草稿模型效率，但它们在高并发下对 VLM 的加速仍然不大（<9%）。为了理解这一差距，我们检查了从目标模型到草稿模型的不同模态之间的信息流，并确定了目标模型和草稿模型之间视觉注意力的稀疏模式：草稿模型中只有一小部分键值头需要上下文中的直接视觉特征关注，并且只有目标模型中顶层的视觉特征需要在上下文中关注。因此，我们提出 VisHead-Spec，它选择一小部分固定的键值 (KV) 头来处理目标模型中顶层的所有图像特征，并将剩余的头限制为文本特征。在 Qwen3-VL-8B 和 MMSpec 上，VisHead-Spec-8 让绘图员的 40 KV 头中的 8 个读取图像，同时将接受的长度保持在块扩散绘图模型基线（即 DSpark）的 0.3% 以内。在批量大小为 64 时，其相对于自回归解码的吞吐量增益增加到 16.0%，而 DSpark 为 9.5%；在批量大小为 1 时，其加速仍然与 DSpark 相当。

papers.title: Latent Lattice Language Models
papers.summary: Language models typically increase per-token computation through deeper or looped layers and latent reasoning steps, while richer residual connections improve information flow across layers. We instead increase computational capacity: the number of active computational states a model maintains. We introduce the Lattice of Latents, a set of per-layer horizontal latent streams that run recurrently along time, alongside the vertical residual stream that flows through depth. Like hyper-connections, mHC, and attention or value residuals, the Lattice enhances the residual stream, but rather than adding or rerouting residual pathways through depth, it provides companion computational states that persist across tokens. Unlike hybrid Transformer-SSM architectures, whose recurrent states primarily serve as internal memory for sequence mixing, these latents directly condition the vertical stream's attention, KV-cache writes, MLP computation, and decoding. On Transformers trained on 20B FineWeb-Edu tokens, a 406M-parameter Lattice model lowers validation perplexity from 15.41 to 14.40 over a parameter-matched Transformer. These gains extend across architectural variants. The Lattice composes with prior residual-stream enhancements: with hyper-connections and input residuals, it lowers validation perplexity from 15.41 (base Transformer) and 14.22 (Transformer with the same enhancements) to 13.61. On Gated DeltaNet, Mamba-2, Triadic GDN, and GDN-Mamba-2 hybrids, it improves perplexity at every tested native state size, with Lattice-GDN and Lattice-Triadic-GDN variants outperforming pure baselines with 4x larger native states. These results identify persistent per-layer state as a complementary axis for scaling language-model computation.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且结果积极，但证据广度仍不足。
pros: 提出“持久分层潜状态”作为区别于深度/循环增算的新扩展轴
在406M规模与多种架构上均报告一致困惑度改进，具跨架构潜力
cons: 仅见20B token与中等规模验证，缺少更大规模、长上下文与吞吐/时延/显存等serving成本评估

papers.title_zh: 潜在格语言模型
papers.summary_zh: 语言模型通常通过更深或循环层和潜在推理步骤增加每个标记的计算，而更丰富的残差连接则改善跨层的信息流。相反，我们增加了计算能力：模型维护的活动计算状态的数量。我们引入了潜在网格，这是一组沿着时间循环运行的每层水平潜在流，以及流过深度的垂直残余流。与超连接、mHC 以及注意力或价值残差一样，格子增强了残差流，但它不是通过深度添加或重新路由残差路径，而是提供跨令牌持续存在的伴随计算状态。与混合 Transformer-SSM 架构不同，混合 Transformer-SSM 架构的循环状态主要充当序列混合的内部存储器，这些潜在变量直接调节垂直流的注意力、KV 缓存写入、MLP 计算和解码。在使用 20B FineWeb-Edu 代币训练的 Transformer 上，与参数匹配的 Transformer 相比，406M 参数的 Lattice 模型将验证困惑度从 15.41 降低到 14.40。这些收益延伸到了不同的架构变体。 Lattice 与先前的残差流增强功能相结合：通过超连接和输入残差，它将验证困惑度从 15.41（基础 Transformer）和 14.22（具有相同增强功能的 Transformer）降低到 13.61。在门控 DeltaNet、Mamba-2、Triadic GDN 和 GDN-Mamba-2 混合体上，它改善了每个测试的本机状态大小的困惑度，Lattice-GDN 和 Lattice-Triadic-GDN 变体的性能优于纯基线，其本机状态大 4 倍。这些结果将持久的每层状态确定为扩展语言模型计算的补充轴。

papers.title: Latent Bridge: Asking for Help Without Words
papers.summary: Text-based model collaboration requires a large model to generate intermediate responses before a smaller model can use its guidance, adding large-model decoding cost to inference. We introduce POND (Prefill-Only, No-Decode), a method that uses a frozen large sender for prefill and a small receiver for all autoregressive decoding. A trainable bridge maps the sender's hidden states to additional attention keys and values, allowing the receiver to use these representations throughout generation. POND also supports periodic review, in which the sender processes the receiver's partial response and updates its guidance through additional prefill passes while preserving the receiver's existing KV cache. Across reasoning and coding benchmarks, POND improves receiver performance with senders from different model families. In particular, GLM-5.3 provides gains comparable to those of Qwen3.8-Max when paired with a Qwen receiver, supporting the effectiveness of representation transfer between independently trained model families. POND further demonstrates its ability to generalize across domains. When trained on math and coding tasks, it transfers directly to general knowledge tasks without additional domain-specific training. These results demonstrate that large frontier model prefill representations can improve small-model generation without requiring large-model autoregressive decoding.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且实用，但证据链仍不够扎实。
pros: 提出“仅大模型预填充+小模型解码”的协作范式，显著降低大模型解码成本
展示跨模型家族与跨任务域迁移能力，具备较强应用潜力
cons: 摘要未充分说明训练开销、对比基线公平性及统计显著性，严谨性存在不确定性
周期性review虽增强效果，但额外预填充轮次可能抬高端到端时延与工程复杂度

papers.title_zh: 潜在桥梁：无言寻求帮助
papers.summary_zh: 基于文本的模型协作需要大型模型生成中间响应，然后较小的模型才能使用其指导，从而增加了推理的大型模型解码成本。我们引入 POND（仅预填充，无解码），这种方法使用冻结的大型发送器进行预填充，并使用小型接收器进行所有自回归解码。可训练的桥将发送者的隐藏状态映射到额外的注意键和值，允许接收者在整个生成过程中使用这些表示。 POND 还支持定期审查，其中发送方处理接收方的部分响应，并通过额外的预填充通道更新其指导，同时保留接收方现有的 KV 缓存。在推理和编码基准测试中，POND 通过来自不同模型系列的发送器提高了接收器性能。特别是，当与 Qwen 接收器配对时，GLM-5.3 提供了与 Qwen3.8-Max 相当的增益，支持独立训练的模型系列之间表示迁移的有效性。 POND 进一步展示了其跨领域泛化的能力。当接受数学和编码任务的培训时，它会直接转移到一般知识任务，而无需额外的特定领域培训。这些结果表明，大前沿模型预填充表示可以改进小模型生成，而不需要大模型自回归解码。

papers.title: SURMA: Efficient Fine-Grained Communication Offload for SuperPOD
papers.summary: GPU SuperPODs underpin large language model (LLM) serving, but growing bandwidth and round-trip times make inter-GPU communication consume increasing compute resources. SM-driven remote memory access occupies shared memory or registers for in-flight data and competes for SM-to-NoC bandwidth. Dedicated engines can free these resources, but must handle fine-grained transfers, down to a 576\,B KV-cache entry. NVIDIA's CopyEngine uses less than 1\% of NVLink bandwidth at 7\,KB granularity. We present SURMA, an on-die Scale-Up Remote Memory Access engine. Adapting RDMA requires overcoming slow doorbell submission, excessive per-application connection state, head-of-line blocking of completion notifications on shared connections, and costly ordering for multipath transfers. SURMA uses a credit-based shared send queue to reduce submission latency from 1.2\,$μ$s to 400\,ns; fused write-with-atomic semantics to share connections while independently notifying each transaction; and Network Per Path Ordering to ensure data arrives before the completion flag without Sender or Receiver Ordering. We implement SURMA in RTL on a two-FPGA prototype and evaluate it with two 8-GPU NVLink servers. At 512\,B granularity, SURMA saturates attainable bandwidth with a single SM, whereas NVLink needs over 14\% of the SMs. SURMA occupies under 0.5\% of GPU area and accelerates inference on four models by 1.05--1.26$\times$ over NVLink.

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 问题重要且方案扎实，但通用性仍待验证。
pros: 聚焦SuperPOD细粒度通信瓶颈，问题定义准确且有现实紧迫性
提出队列、通知与排序协同机制，并有RTL与双FPGA原型及端到端推理收益
cons: 评估平台与规模仍偏受限，对不同互连拓扑和更大集群的可迁移性证据不足

papers.title_zh: SURMA：SuperPOD 的高效细粒度通信卸载
papers.summary_zh: GPU SuperPOD 支持大型语言模型 (LLM) 服务，但不断增长的带宽和往返时间使得 GPU 间通信消耗越来越多的计算资源。 SM 驱动的远程内存访问占用共享内存或寄存器来存储传输中的数据，并竞争 SM 到 NoC 的带宽。专用引擎可以释放这些资源，但必须处理细粒度的传输，低至 576\,B KV 缓存条目。 NVIDIA 的 CopyEngine 在 7KB 粒度下仅使用不到 1% 的 NVLink 带宽。我们推出 SURMA，一种片上扩展远程内存访问引擎。适应 RDMA 需要克服缓慢的门铃提交、每个应用程序连接状态过多、共享连接上完成通知的队头阻塞以及多路径传输的昂贵排序。 SURMA 使用基于信用的共享发送队列，将提交延迟从 1.2\,$μ$s 降低到 400\,ns；融合写入与原子语义以共享连接，同时独立通知每个事务；和网络每路径排序，以确保数据在完成标志之前到达，而无需发送方或接收方排序。我们在两个 FPGA 原型上以 RTL 方式实现 SURMA，并使用两个 8-GPU NVLink 服务器对其进行评估。在 512\,B 粒度下，SURMA 使用单个 SM 使可达到的带宽饱和，而 NVLink 需要超过 14\% 的 SM。 SURMA 占用的 GPU 面积不到 0.5%，与 NVLink 相比，四个模型的推理速度提高了 1.05--1.26$\times$。

papers.title: MiSTiQ: MicroScaling Trellis Quantization for Extreme KV Cache Compression
papers.summary: Modern large language models (LLMs) increasingly support longer contexts and serve more concurrent requests, increasing both sequence lengths and batch sizes. Both trends increase KV-cache size and memory traffic during inference. KV-cache quantization reduces these costs, with recent approaches using codebook-based vector quantization to achieve extremely low bit widths. However, hardware constraints limit codebook size, and most methods reconstruct the cache in higher-precision floating-point formats for attention, limiting the computational benefits of quantization. To address these limitations, we introduce MiSTiQ, a drop-in replacement for codebook-based vector quantizers that combines trellis-coded storage with microscaling (MX) formats for low-precision computation. We combine trellis quantization with beam search to encode the KV cache over large reconstruction spaces without large codebooks. To support MX computation, we derive MX-Hash functions that generate reconstruction values directly in the target MX element format. These functions use the scale-conditioned marginal distribution of block-normalized Gaussian inputs. On Llama3 and Qwen3, MiSTiQ achieves lower WikiText perplexity and higher GSM8K accuracy than the evaluated baselines across several block-scale formats at approximately 1.25 effective bits per element. With NVFP4, it also achieves the highest LongBench average on both models.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且实用，但证据完整性仍待加强。
pros: 将trellis量化与MX低精计算结合，面向真实硬件约束有针对性
在约1.25比特/元素下兼顾困惑度、推理准确率与长上下文基准表现
cons: 摘要未体现训练/推理开销、延迟吞吐与跨硬件实测，严谨性与可复现性风险仍在

papers.title_zh: MiSTiQ：用于极端 KV 缓存压缩的 MicroScaling Trellis 量化
papers.summary_zh: 现代大型语言模型 (LLM) 越来越多地支持更长的上下文并服务更多的并发请求，从而增加了序列长度和批量大小。这两种趋势都会增加推理期间的 KV 缓存大小和内存流量。 KV 缓存量化降低了这些成本，最近的方法使用基于码本的矢量量化来实现极低的位宽度。然而，硬件限制限制了码本的大小，并且大多数方法以更高精度的浮点格式重建缓存以引起注意，从而限制了量化的计算优势。为了解决这些限制，我们引入了 MiSTiQ，它是基于码本的矢量量化器的直接替代品，它将网格编码存储与微缩放 (MX) 格式相结合，以进行低精度计算。我们将网格量化与波束搜索相结合，在没有大型码本的情况下在大型重建空间上对 KV 缓存进行编码。为了支持 MX 计算，我们派生了 MX-Hash 函数，直接以目标 MX 元素格式生成重建值。这些函数使用块归一化高斯输入的尺度条件边缘分布。在 Llama3 和 Qwen3 上，MiSTiQ 在每个元素大约 1.25 有效位的情况下，比多个块级格式的评估基线实现了更低的 WikiText 困惑度和更高的 GSM8K 准确度。借助 NVFP4，它还在两种型号上实现了最高的 LongBench 平均值。

papers.title: A Matter of Stages: Energy-Latency Trade-offs in Multimodal LLM Serving
papers.summary: Online serving of multimodal large language models requires deciding whether to separate visual encoding (E), prefill (P), and decode (D) across GPUs and how to configure their frequencies. EPD disaggregation enables independent stage control, but it also changes communication and queueing behavior. Lowering one stage's frequency can increase queueing and prolong execution across the EPD pipeline. Consequently, reducing power at one stage does not necessarily reduce total GPU energy per request. In this paper, we systematically characterize fused and EPD-disaggregated serving across four multimodal models under a fixed three-GPU budget, followed by single-stage and uniform downclocking experiments across 18 workload combinations. We find that disaggregation reduces GPU energy per successful request by 13.3-37.0% at nearly identical output-token throughput, but increases mean TTFT. Downclocking exhibits distinct stage sensitivities, and aggressive frequency reductions can offset power savings through queueing and longer execution. Across the evaluated workloads, uniform downclocking to 80% reduces GPU energy by 11.7-18.6% with modest mean-latency changes. Guided by these findings, we develop a budgeted frequency exploration strategy to select energy-efficient configurations under latency constraints. Evaluation shows that four probes can identify the lowest-energy feasible configuration among 25 measured candidates across all 288 evaluated positive-margin SLO scenarios. These results provide practical guidance for energy-efficient multimodal serving.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 选题务实扎实，对多模态服务节能具实用价值。
pros: 系统比较融合与EPD解耦及分频策略，实验覆盖面广且结论一致
提出预算受限频率探索法，样本效率高并直接面向SLO约束部署
cons: 创新更偏工程优化与经验规律，理论建模与可证明性相对不足
固定三卡预算与特定模型集合可能限制跨硬件和更大规模场景外推

papers.title_zh: 阶段问题：多模式 LLM 服务中的能源延迟权衡
papers.summary_zh: 多模态大语言模型的在线服务需要决定是否跨 GPU 分离视觉编码 (E)、预填充 (P) 和解码 (D) 以及如何配置它们的频率。 EPD 分解实现了独立的阶段控制，但它也改变了通信和排队行为。降低某一阶段的频率会增加排队并延长 EPD 管道的执行时间。因此，降低某一阶段的功耗并不一定会降低每个请求的 GPU 总能量。在本文中，我们系统地描述了在固定的三 GPU 预算下跨四个多模式模型的融合和 EPD 分解服务的特征，然后在 18 种工作负载组合中进行了单级和统一降频实验。我们发现，在输出令牌吞吐量几乎相同的情况下，分解将每个成功请求的 GPU 能耗降低了 13.3-37.0%，但增加了平均 TTFT。降频表现出不同的阶段敏感性，并且大幅降低频率可以抵消通过排队和更长的执行时间节省的功率。在评估的工作负载中，统一降频至 80% 可将 GPU 能耗降低 11.7-18.6%，平均延迟变化不大。在这些发现的指导下，我们制定了预算频率探索策略，以在延迟限制下选择节能配置。评估表明，四个探针可以在所有 288 个评估的正裕度 SLO 场景中的 25 个测量候选者中识别出最低能量的可行配置。这些结果为节能多式联运服务提供了实用指导。

papers.title: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB: An Open and Efficient Small Language Model for Fast Conversational Agents
papers.summary: We introduce Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB, an open and efficient small language model further post-trained from Gemma-4-E4B-it and optimized for speed and intelligence per GB of memory used for fast conversational agents. The model carries forward Gemma's strong conversational capabilities and further improves multi-turn tool use, instruction following, and input grounding for fast, local voice/device assistants, interactive personas, and embedded/Edge interfaces. The model combines natural conversation with multi-turn agentic capabilities to power voice/device assistants, interactive characters and robotic/IoT interfaces running on GeForce RTX, Jetson, and RTX/DGX Spark. Experiments on 21 benchmarks show that Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB achieves the highest average accuracy while generating the fewest output tokens in both reasoning and non-reasoning modes, compared with Gemma-4-E4B-it and Qwen3.5-4B. The model is released with a DFlash drafter. With DFlash, Bolt E4B achieves $2.74\times$ the per-user decode speed of inference without speculative decoding at concurrency~1, and $1.21\times$ the generation throughput of Gemma-4-E4B-it with MTP at batch size 1.
papers.comment: Animated versions of Figure 3 are available in the blog: https://research.nvidia.com/labs/nemotron/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-E4B-4GB/

quality.label: 中等
quality.verdict: 工程优化亮眼，但研究严谨性证据不足。
pros: 面向4GB内存与边缘部署的目标清晰，应用价值高。
同时报告精度、token效率与吞吐增益，实用导向强。
cons: 核心方法细节（后训练配方、数据与对齐策略）未披露，难复现与归因。
21项基准的统计显著性、方差与公平对比设置未说明，结论稳健性有限。

papers.title_zh: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB：用于快速会话代理的开放高效的小语言模型
papers.summary_zh: 我们推出 Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB，这是一种开放且高效的小型语言模型，经过 Gemma-4-E4B-it 进一步后训练，并针对用于快速对话代理的每 GB 内存的速度和智能进行了优化。该模型继承了 Gemma 强大的对话功能，并进一步改进了多轮工具使用、指令遵循和快速本地语音/设备助手、交互式角色和嵌入式/边缘接口的输入基础。该模型将自然对话与多轮代理功能相结合，为在 GeForce RTX、Jetson 和 RTX/DGX Spark 上运行的语音/设备助手、交互式角色和机器人/物联网接口提供支持。 21 个基准测试的实验表明，与 Gemma-4-E4B-it 和 Qwen3.5-4B 相比，Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB 在推理和非推理模式下均实现了最高的平均准确率，同时生成最少的输出标记。该模型是通过 DFlash 绘图器发布的。借助 DFlash，Bolt E4B 在并发~1 时实现了 2.74 美元\times 的每用户推理解码速度（无需推测解码），以及在批量大小为 1 时使用 MTP 的 Gemma-4-E4B-it 的生成吞吐量 1.21\times$。

papers.title: MSAR: Next-Scale Autoregressive Forecasting for Time Series via Modular Multi-Scale Decoupling
papers.summary: Time series forecasting underpins critical applications in finance, energy, healthcare, and transportation. Although deep models have achieved strong results, most adopt single-scale modeling or restrict multiscale processing to the input side, causing a misalignment between multiscale inputs and single-scale outputs and limiting predictive power. We introduce the Modular Scale-wise Autoregressive Framework (MSAR), a model-agnostic design that forecasts progressively across multiple temporal resolutions. MSAR offers three advantages: (1) scale-wise aligned modeling, which disentangles heterogeneous temporal patterns by aligning inputs and outputs at each scale; (2) scale-wise autoregression, where coarse-scale predictions guide finer-scale forecasting through hierarchical information flow; and (3) a modular architecture, enabling seamless integration with diverse backbones such as CNNs, MLPs, and Transformers. Extensive experiments across a broad set of datasets and forecasting models demonstrate that MSAR achieves consistent improvements in both accuracy and inference efficiency, validating the effectiveness of scale-aligned autoregression for multiscale time series forecasting. The code is available at: https://github.com/Oryxo/MSAR.
papers.comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026 main track. 26 pages, 7 figures. Code available at https://github.com/Oryxo/MSAR

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路实用但证据尚不足以支撑强结论。
pros: 提出按尺度对齐的自回归框架，问题定义清晰且具工程可迁移性
强调模块化可接入多类骨干网络，潜在落地范围较广
cons: 摘要未给出关键定量结果与统计显著性，严格性与可复现性判断受限
“提升推理效率”缺少吞吐/时延/FLOPs等明确证据，服务价值尚待验证

papers.title_zh: MSAR：通过模块化多尺度解耦进行时间序列的下一代自回归预测
papers.summary_zh: 时间序列预测支撑着金融、能源、医疗保健和交通运输领域的关键应用。尽管深度模型取得了很好的成果，但大多数采用单尺度建模或将多尺度处理限制在输入侧，导致多尺度输入和单尺度输出之间的错位，限制了预测能力。我们引入了模块化尺度自回归框架（MSAR），这是一种与模型无关的设计，可以跨多个时间分辨率逐步进行预测。 MSAR 具有三个优点：（1）按尺度对齐建模，通过对齐每个尺度的输入和输出来解开异构时间模式； （2）尺度自回归，其中粗尺度预测通过分层信息流指导更细尺度的预测； (3) 模块化架构，可与 CNN、MLP 和 Transformer 等不同骨干网无缝集成。在广泛的数据集和预测模型中进行的大量实验表明，MSAR 在准确性和推理效率方面实现了持续改进，验证了尺度对齐自回归在多尺度时间序列预测中的有效性。该代码位于：https://github.com/Oryxo/MSAR。

papers.title: Memory-Efficient Speculative Decoding with Quantized Draft KV Cache
papers.summary: Speculative decoding reduces generation cost, but it stores two KV caches: one for the target model and one for the draft model. We reduce this extra memory by quantizing the draft cache. The target cache and verifier remain in BF16, so that compression cannot change the target model's final correction rule. We first study how to divide precision between keys and values. A naive per-token quantizer makes keys appear much more sensitive: splitting a 12-bit budget, K8V4 beats K4V8 in acceptance by 10.87pp. However, with grouped per-channel keys, the gap becomes -0.25pp. A controlled Qwen test confirms that changing only the key quantizer can erase or reverse the preferred bit split. Hence, following KIVI, we propose K4V4 quantization with per-channel keys and per-token values. Across six model pairs, our method reduces draft cache memory by 66.20%, and combined memory across both caches by 23.95%. Mean acceptance drops from 57.93% to 57.14%, only 1.36% relative. Overall, quantized draft caches can make speculative decoding more memory efficient; as a predictive principle for efficient AI design, key and value precision must be co-designed with the quantizer layout.
papers.comment: Accepted at the AXIOM Foundations of Efficient Deep Learning Workshop at NeurIPS 2026

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题实用、结论可信，但方法增量有限。
pros: 抓住推理内存瓶颈，保持目标模型校正规则不变，工程可落地性强
通过量化布局对照实验揭示K/V位宽与量化器耦合关系，经验结论有指导价值
cons: 创新主要是已知量化策略在草稿KV缓存上的组合应用，跨模型泛化与端到端时延/吞吐收益证据仍偏有限

papers.title_zh: 使用量化草稿 KV 缓存进行内存高效推测解码
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码降低了生成成本，但它存储了两个 KV 缓存：一个用于目标模型，一个用于草稿模型。我们通过量化草稿缓存来减少额外的内存。目标缓存和验证器保留在BF16中，因此压缩不能改变目标模型的最终校正规则。我们首先研究如何划分键和值之间的精度。一个朴素的每个令牌量化器使密钥显得更加敏感：分割 12 位预算，K8V4 在接受度上击败了 K4V8 10.87pp。然而，对于按通道分组的键，间隙变为 -0.25pp。受控的 Qwen 测试证实，仅更改关键量化器就可以擦除或反转首选的位分割。因此，在 KIVI 之后，我们提出了具有每通道键和每令牌值的 K4V4 量化。在六个模型对中，我们的方法将草稿缓存内存减少了 66.20%，并将两个缓存的组合内存减少了 23.95%。平均接受度从 57.93% 下降至 57.14%，相对仅下降 1.36%。总体而言，量化草稿缓存可以使推测解码更加内存高效；作为高效 AI 设计的预测原则，键和值精度必须与量化器布局共同设计。

papers.title: GaugeRoPE: RoPE-Compatible Executable Latent Attention
papers.summary: Latent KV cache compression reduces memory footprint by mapping historical keys and values into compact representations. However, generic compressed key states require reconstruction to native dimension before applying RoPE and computing attention scores, adding sequence-scaling overhead to the decode path. We characterize when a latent KV representation can serve directly as the execution state of pretrained RoPE. For RoPE-based transformers, exact static linear execution of the rotary key path requires the latent-to-native map to preserve the pretrained RoPE action through an intertwining relation, restricting exact mixing to coordinates that share the same RoPE frequency. Guided by this characterization, we build GaugeRoPE, a training-free executable latent KV representation. It combines a RoPE-compatible carrier that preserves the rotary action with an approximate position-independent residual key--value (RKV) correction for complementary key and value information, both evaluated without per-token dense historical K/V reconstruction. On Mistral-7B, GaugeRoPE achieves $5.85\times$ KV compression while maintaining quality close to the full-cache baseline. Additional MHA results validate the construction beyond GQA. GaugeRoPE achieves up to $2.48\times$ the decode throughput of the vanilla uncompressed baseline through direct latent execution.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 理论切中痛点，方法实用但证据尚不充分。
pros: 提出RoPE可执行潜状态的结构刻画，理论动机清晰
训练免费且解码端免重构，压缩率与吞吐提升兼具工程价值
cons: 实验范围看似偏窄（主要Mistral-7B），跨模型/长上下文/端到端延迟与质量鲁棒性仍需更强验证

papers.title_zh: GaugeRoPE：与 RoPE 兼容的可执行潜在注意力
papers.summary_zh: 潜在的 KV 缓存压缩通过将历史键和值映射为紧凑的表示来减少内存占用。然而，通用压缩关键状态需要在应用 RoPE 和计算注意力分数之前重建到本机维度，从而增加了解码路径的序列缩放开销。我们描述了潜在 KV 表示何时可以直接用作预训练 RoPE 的执行状态。对于基于 RoPE 的变压器，旋转键路径的精确静态线性执行需要潜在到本机映射来通过交织关系保留预训练的 RoPE 动作，从而将精确混合限制为共享相同 RoPE 频率的坐标。在此特征的指导下，我们构建了 GaugeRoPE，一种免训练的可执行潜在 KV 表示。它结合了与 RoPE 兼容的载体，该载体保留了旋转动作，并具有近似位置无关的剩余键值 (RKV) 校正，用于补充键和值信息，两者都无需按令牌密集历史 K/V 重建进行评估。在 Mistral-7B 上，GaugeRoPE 实现了 $5.85\times$ KV 压缩，同时保持接近全缓存基线的质量。其他 MHA 结果验证了 GQA 之外的结构。 GaugeRoPE 通过直接潜在执行实现了普通未压缩基线的解码吞吐量高达 $2.48\times$。

papers.title: PoCoAttn: Position-Content Collaborative Sparse Attention for Fast and High-Fidelity Video Generation
papers.summary: Video diffusion transformers rely on 3D full attention over tens of thousands of spatiotemporal tokens, and its quadratic cost dominates inference latency. Sparse attention reduces this cost, but existing methods face a dilemma: static methods apply predefined masks and cannot capture input-dependent attention, whereas dynamic methods reconstruct the sparse mask repeatedly, paying online to rediscover positional structure that is largely stable across inputs. To this end, we propose PoCoAttn, a training-free sparse attention framework that separates input-stable from input-dependent attention and resolves the former offline and the latter online. PoCoAttn features: (1) A relative-offset analysis of 3D query-key pairs, which shows that video attention decomposes into an input-stable positional prior that carries most of the attention mass and a small content-dependent residual. (2) A position-content collaborative sparse attention mechanism, which retrieves positional keys from offline-calibrated tables, selects content keys online with a head-adaptive ratio between the two sources, and compensates for the discarded keys to approximate full attention. (3) A step-adaptive budget allocation algorithm, which models how early-step sparse attention errors are amplified along the denoising trajectory and derives the optimal sparsity budget per step. Extensive experiments across four video diffusion models and three tasks show that PoCoAttn consistently achieves a better speed-fidelity Pareto frontier than state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods, improving PSNR by 1.9 to 5.0 dB over baselines and delivering up to 4.1$\times$ attention and 2.0$\times$ denoising speedups over dense FlashAttention-3 attention.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 15 figures, 13 tables. Project page: https://ecoai-group.github.io/pocoattn

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且实用，但证据完整性待验证。
pros: 提出离线位置先验与在线内容残差协同稀疏化，抓住现有方法关键痛点。
含步级预算分配与多模型多任务结果，速度-保真折中叙事较完整。
cons: 当前结论主要来自摘要，缺少统计显著性、消融充分性与极端场景鲁棒性细节，SOTA优势可信度仍待正文支撑。

papers.title_zh: PoCoAttn：位置内容协作稀疏注意力，用于快速、高保真视频生成
papers.summary_zh: 视频扩散变压器依赖于对数万个时空标记的 3D 全面关注，其二次成本主导了推理延迟。稀疏注意力降低了这种成本，但现有方法面临困境：静态方法应用预定义的掩模，无法捕获依赖于输入的注意力，而动态方法重复重建稀疏掩模，在线付费以重新发现在输入之间基本稳定的位置结构。为此，我们提出了 PoCoAttn，一种免训练的稀疏注意力框架，它将输入稳定注意力与输入依赖注意力分开，并解决前者离线和后者在线的问题。 PoCoAttn 特征：（1）3D 查询密钥对的相对偏移分析，表明视频注意力分解为输入稳定的位置先验，其中包含大部分注意力质量和少量内容相关残差。 （2）位置-内容协作稀疏注意机制，从离线校准表中检索位置键，以两个源之间的头部自适应比率在线选择内容键，并补偿丢弃的键以接近完全注意。 (3) 步长自适应预算分配算法，对早期步稀疏注意力误差如何沿去噪轨迹放大进行建模，并导出每步的最佳稀疏预算。跨四个视频扩散模型和三个任务的大量实验表明，PoCoAttn 始终比最先进的 (SOTA) 方法实现更好的速度保真度帕累托前沿，将 PSNR 比基线提高 1.9 至 5.0 dB，并在密集的 FlashAttention-3 注意力基础上提供高达 4.1$\times$ 的注意力和 2.0$\times$ 的去噪加速。

papers.title: Weights & Caches: LLMs Can Program Tabular Foundation Models
papers.summary: Neural networks are typically programmed through optimization, rather than by explicitly specifying their computations. Recent work on weight-space programming suggests that large language models (LLMs) can instead reason about and manipulate neural-network weights directly. In this work, we show that LLMs can directly program statistical computations in tabular foundation models (TFMs), whose parameters enable inference across different datasets. We investigate three complementary settings using GPT-6 Astra, without gradient-based optimization. First, Astra directly programs nanoTabPFN from zero-initialized weights, achieving a mean ROC AUC of 0.849 across 20 TabArena datasets, compared to 0.876 for a pretrained baseline. Second, Astra diagnoses and repairs a signed-product regression failure in pretrained TabPFN-3.5, restoring near-perfect predictions on held-out synthetic datasets while preserving performance on TabArena-Lite, with only a 0.08% average relative increase in error. Third, it writes KV-cache-editing programs that steer TabPFN-3.5's predictions on unseen synthetic datasets, demonstrating transformations such as reversing linear trends and converting sine waves into approximate square waves, without modifying model weights. Together, our findings suggest that LLM-driven programming could complement gradient-based optimization across TFMs' development and usage, while offering a new way to investigate and intervene in their internal computations.

quality.label: 中等
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且有启发，但实证严谨性仍不足。
pros: 提出LLM直接编程TFM权重与缓存的统一视角，概念新颖
覆盖从零编程、故障修复到KV缓存干预三类场景，展示方法广度
cons: 关键结论主要来自单一LLM与特定模型组合，泛化性与可复现性存疑
缺少与强基线和消融的充分对比，难以量化真实增益来源

papers.title_zh: 权重和缓存：法学硕士可以对表格基础模型进行编程
papers.summary_zh: 神经网络通常通过优化进行编程，而不是通过明确指定其计算。最近关于权重空间编程的研究表明，大型语言模型（LLM）可以直接推理和操纵神经网络权重。在这项工作中，我们表明法学硕士可以直接在表格基础模型（TFM）中对统计计算进行编程，其参数可以跨不同数据集进行推理。我们使用 GPT-6 Astra 研究了三种互补设置，没有基于梯度的优化。首先，Astra 直接从零初始化权重对 nanoTabPFN 进行编程，在 20 个 TabArena 数据集中实现了 0.849 的平均 ROC AUC，而预训练基线的平均 ROC AUC 为 0.876。其次，Astra 诊断并修复了预训练 TabPFN-3.5 中的符号乘积回归故障，恢复了对保留的合成数据集的近乎完美的预测，同时保留了 TabArena-Lite 上的性能，平均相对误差仅增加了 0.08%。第三，它编写了 KV 缓存编辑程序，引导 TabPFN-3.5 对未见过的合成数据集进行预测，演示诸如反转线性趋势和将正弦波转换为近似方波等转换，而无需修改模型权重。总之，我们的研究结果表明，LLM 驱动的编程可以补充 TFM 开发和使用中基于梯度的优化，同时提供一种研究和干预其内部计算的新方法。

papers.title: Making Preemption Productive in Long-Output LLM Serving
papers.summary: Reasoning LLMs generate long outputs whose key--value (KV) caches occupy GPU memory for minutes. When memory fills, the server preempts requests, and a preempted request can repeatedly lose and recover its state while producing little new output. We call this behavior KV thrashing. In certain cases, existing systems leave more than a fifth of requests stalled for over a minute. Because preemption cannot be avoided without delaying admission, we ask how to make it productive. We present Stint, a serving system that preserves a preempted request's work, bounds how long it waits, and gives it fresh output after it returns. Stint stores fixed-length KV snapshots in a contiguity-first CPU pool with an exact-extent allocator, and moves them with fused K/V gather/scatter kernels and double buffering. Age-based readmission brings stalled requests back, and protection gives them a turn of fresh decoding before another preemption. Remaining-length estimates from decoding hidden states guide victim selection. On olympiad-math replays with Qwen3-32B on H200 GPUs, no request pauses for more than 50 seconds under Stint and p99 time per output token falls by 50.7\% relative to recomputation in the same engine. The replay as a whole finishes 10.7\% sooner (12.0\% higher throughput), because the requests that baselines starve no longer finish last.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题抓得准，方案务实有效但证据仍偏单一。
pros: 准确识别长输出场景的KV thrashing并提出可执行系统化对策
机制设计完整（快照/回收/重入/保护/受害者选择）且性能收益显著
cons: 评测主要基于单模型单任务重放，跨模型与在线真实负载泛化性待验证
与更多强基线及成本指标（CPU内存占用、迁移开销、尾延迟稳定性）对比仍不充分

papers.title_zh: 在长输出 LLM 服务中使先发制人变得富有成效
papers.summary_zh: 推理 LLM 会生成长输出，其键值 (KV) 缓存会占用 GPU 内存数分钟。当内存填满时，服务器会抢占请求，并且被抢占的请求可能会反复丢失和恢复其状态，同时产生很少的新输出。我们将这种行为称为 KV 抖动。在某些情况下，现有系统会使超过五分之一的请求停滞一分钟以上。由于在不延迟准入的情况下无法避免抢占，因此我们询问如何使其富有成效。我们提出了 Stint，一个服务系统，它保留抢占请求的工作，限制其等待时间，并在返回后为其提供新的输出。 Stint 将固定长度的 KV 快照存储在具有精确范围分配器的连续优先 CPU 池中，并使用融合的 K/V 收集/分散内核和双缓冲来移动它们。基于年龄的重新接纳可以恢复停滞的请求，而保护可以让它们在另一次抢占之前进行新的解码。解码隐藏状态的剩余长度估计指导受害者选择。在 H200 GPU 上使用 Qwen3-32B 进行奥林匹克数学重播时，Stint 下没有请求暂停超过 50 秒，并且每个输出令牌的 p99 时间相对于同一引擎中的重新计算下降了 50.7%。重播整体上完成速度快了 10.7%（吞吐量提高了 12.0%），因为基线饥饿的请求不再最后完成。

papers.title: High-Throughput Serving of Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe with Regime-Aware Megakernels and Kernel Fusion
papers.summary: Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe ranks first among open-weight models on the Hugging Face Open ASR leaderboards. Serving it efficiently takes more than fast operators: continuous batching changes the amount and mix of work at every iteration, and the best fusion granularity changes with it. We present a serving engine that, for every pass, chooses between persistent megakernels and chains of fused kernels at crossovers measured offline. On an H100 SXM GPU, throughput of our accuracy-preserving serving peaks at 4,345x real time, 1.39x the peak of tuned vLLM, and is up to 4.39x faster at low concurrency; on B200 it peaks at 6,367x, 1.64x vLLM at the highest concurrency we measured. Word error rate (WER) is 1.91 to 1.93% against 1.88 to 1.93% for vLLM. Within a 400 ms budget for p95 end-to-end completion time, it serves 8x as many concurrent requests. Choosing per pass beats either level alone: 23% higher throughput than always using megakernels at 128 concurrent requests, and 9% higher than always using fused kernels at 8. Opt-in switches, including greedy MoE layer skipping, add 13 to 16% throughput on B200 for offline jobs that can accept higher WER.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 工程价值高，但方法新颖性与可泛化性待验证。
pros: 面向动态连续批处理提出按pass选择融合粒度，贴合真实serving负载变化
给出H100/B200上吞吐、并发与时延预算下的系统级收益，且基本保持ASR精度
cons: 核心思想偏系统工程调优，理论新意与可迁移到其他模型/任务的证据不足

papers.title_zh: 具有机制感知巨型内核和内核融合的 Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe 高吞吐量服务
papers.summary_zh: Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe 在 Hugging Face Open ASR 排行榜上的开放权重模型中排名第一。高效地提供服务需要的不仅仅是快速的运算符：连续批处理会改变每次迭代的工作量和组合，最佳融合粒度也会随之变化。我们提出了一个服务引擎，对于每次传递，它都会在离线测量的交叉处的持久巨型内核和融合内核链之间进行选择。在 H100 SXM GPU 上，我们的准确性保持服务的吞吐量峰值为 4,345 倍实时，是调优 vLLM 峰值的 1.39 倍，并且在低并发时速度提高了 4.39 倍；在 B200 上，在我们测量的最高并发度下，其峰值为 6,367 倍，vLLM 为 1.64 倍。单词错误率 (WER) 为 1.91 至 1.93%，vLLM 为 1.88 至 1.93%。在 p95 端到端完成时间 400 毫秒的预算内，它可以服务 8 倍的并发请求。选择单次传递优于单独使用任一级别：在 128 个并发请求下，比始终使用巨型内核的吞吐量高 23%，比在 8 个并发请求时始终使用融合内核的吞吐量高 9%。选择加入开关（包括贪婪的 MoE 层跳过）可为可以接受更高 WER 的离线作业在 B200 上增加 13% 到 16% 的吞吐量。

papers.title: LoopSkim: Lossless Multi-Depth Speculative Decoding for Looped Language Models
papers.summary: Looped language models such as Ouro and Raven apply one weight-shared block several times per token, so autoregressive decoding (AR) runs every loop of every token in sequence. Pipelined self-speculative decoders overlap these loops by drafting tokens from shallow readouts and verifying them at full depth. Yet every loop of a looped LM ends in a readout of the next token, and draft tokens pass through every depth anyway, so each depth can check them without an extra pass. We introduce LoopSkim, in which the depth of the pipeline is the verifier. Draft tokens copied from the context, as in prompt lookup decoding, enter after the first loops, any later readout that contradicts one replaces it at that depth, and only full-depth readouts commit tokens. LoopSkim fixes the random draws of every position in advance, so each check compares two tokens and decoding stays lossless in exact arithmetic under sampling for any number of checks and draft chains. Without training, its speedup over AR averages 1.73x that of LoopSpec across greedy decoding and sampling, and its checks between the first loops and full depth speed it up on every model. An optional draft head adds a second chain and raises this average to 1.99x.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且实用，但严谨性证据仍偏不足。
pros: 将循环深度本身作为校验器，避免额外验证前向，设计简洁且契合looped LM结构
强调在采样下的无损性并宣称无需训练即可获得稳定加速，潜在工程价值高
cons: 摘要缺少关键实验细节与统计稳健性信息（模型规模、长上下文/高温采样退化、端到端系统开销），无损性在有限精度实现中的可复现风险仍待证明

papers.title_zh: LoopSkim：循环语言模型的无损多深度推测解码
papers.summary_zh: Ouro 和 Raven 等循环语言模型对每个 token 多次应用一个权重共享块，因此自回归解码 (AR) 按顺序运行每个 token 的每个循环。流水线自推测解码器通过从浅读出中起草标记并在全深度验证它们来重叠这些循环。然而，循环 LM 的每个循环都以读取下一个令牌结束，并且草案令牌无论如何都会经过每个深度，因此每个深度都可以检查它们，而无需额外的传递。我们引入LoopSkim，其中管道的深度就是验证者。从上下文复制的草稿令牌，如在提示查找解码中，在第一个循环之后输入，任何与一个循环相矛盾的后续读出都会在该深度替换它，并且只有全深度读出才会提交令牌。 LoopSkim 提前修复了每个位置的随机抽取，因此每次检查都会比较两个令牌，并且在任意数量的检查和草案链的采样下，解码在精确算术中保持无损。在没有训练的情况下，它在贪婪解码和采样方面比 AR 平均加速了 LoopSpec 的 1.73 倍，并且它在第一个循环和全深度之间的检查在每个模型上都加速了它。可选的牵引头添加了第二条链条，并将该平均值提高到 1.99 倍。

papers.title: EfficientSkill: Learning Skills for Token-Efficient Multi-Turn Agents
papers.summary: Reflective skill optimizers improve multi-turn LLM agents by revising instructions from failed and successful rollouts, yet accumulating edge-case rules bloats prompts, inflates token use, and pushes agents into long, error-prone loops. We introduce EfficientSkill, a two-step framework that first discovers a reliable skill without token penalties, and then warm-starts accuracy-guarded pruning from that skill to compress instructions, bound agent turns, and offload reusable code into workspace utilities with zero implementation prompt cost. Across four frontier, mid-tier, and open-weight models on MATH-500, ALFWorld, and SpreadsheetBench, EfficientSkill cuts output tokens over unconstrained EvoSkill on 11 of 12 configurations (by up to 80%) while raising mean accuracy on every benchmark, including +14.3 and +17.5 percentage-point gains on SpreadsheetBench with Gemini 3.8 Flash and Grok 4.1 Fast by replacing stalled loops with compact workflows. By shrinking both generated tokens and replayed history, EfficientSkill lowers total token usage and serving cost across every evaluated configuration, with or without full-prefix KV caching.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，效果可观，但新颖性与证据强度中等。
pros: 聚焦多轮代理的令牌效率与循环失败，研究问题重要且实用
在多模型多基准上同时提升准确率并降低总token成本，应用价值较高
cons: 方法更像流程整合与工程优化，核心机制新颖性有限，且摘要未充分说明统计显著性与消融细节

papers.title_zh: EfficientSkill：令牌高效多轮代理的学习技能
papers.summary_zh: 反思技能优化器通过修改失败和成功推出的指令来改进多回合 LLM 代理，但累积的边缘情况规则会导致提示膨胀、增加令牌使用，并将代理推入冗长且容易出错的循环。我们引入了 EfficientSkill，一个两步框架，首先发现没有令牌惩罚的可靠技能，然后从该技能热启动精确度保护的修剪，以压缩指令、绑定代理轮流，并将可重用代码卸载到工作区实用程序中，实现提示成本为零。在 MATH-500、ALFWorld 和 SpreadsheetBench 上的四个前沿、中层和开放权重模型中，EfficientSkill 在 12 个配置中的 11 个配置上比不受约束的 EvoSkill 减少了输出标记（高达 80%），同时提高了每个基准的平均准确度，包括通过替换使用 Gemini 3.8 Flash 和 Grok 4.1 Fast 在 SpreadsheetBench 上获得 +14.3 和 +17.5 个百分点的收益具有紧凑工作流程的停滞循环。通过缩小生成的令牌和重播历史记录，EfficientSkill 降低了每个评估配置（无论有或没有全前缀 KV 缓存）的总令牌使用量和服务成本。

papers.title: Multi-Branch Transformer
papers.summary: Transformer language models are commonly scaled by making their blocks wider or stacking them deeper. In this work, we explore a complementary path: branching, the parallel composition of full Transformer blocks. We introduce the Multi-Branch Transformer (MBT), which processes the input through shared initial layers, executes independently parameterized branches of sequential blocks in parallel, and fuses their outputs before shared final layers. At comparable training compute, we study three MBT variants: Wide-Shallow preserves block width, Narrow-Deep preserves sequential depth, and Balanced interpolates between them. In controlled pretraining experiments at four mixture-of-experts scales (0.8B to 2.1B total parameters), 2-branch Wide-Shallow MBTs consistently outperform sequential Transformers under matched parameter and training-compute budgets. Balanced MBTs improve further and retain comparable quality as the number of branches increases. To improve inference efficiency at long contexts, we introduce Joint-KV, which constructs a shared KV cache from branch representations at each depth. Our final recipe combines Balanced MBTs with Joint-KV, supported by an inference engine that exploits branch grouping and shared-cache reuse. Fitted scaling curves indicate that standard Transformers require up to 1.26x as much training body compute to match our final models' validation loss. These models reduce full-model KV-cache storage by up to 34% and deliver up to 51.4% higher decoding throughput on a single H200 GPU. Ablation studies show that branching yields gains beyond changes in width and depth, enables an effective KV-sharing strategy (Joint-KV), remains robust across fusion functions, and performs best in the middle layers. These findings show that branching offers a practical path for scaling language models toward both better modeling quality and faster inference.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且工程价值高，但外推证据仍不足。
pros: 提出分支化Transformer与Joint-KV结合，兼顾精度与推理吞吐
在同参同算力对照下报告稳定收益，并给出消融与缩放曲线支持
cons: 实验规模与场景仍偏受限（2.1B以内、单卡吞吐为主），跨更大模型与多硬件泛化待验证
Joint-KV可能引入表示耦合与训练/部署复杂度，长期稳定性与维护成本未充分量化

papers.title_zh: 多支路变压器
papers.summary_zh: Transformer 语言模型通常通过使块更宽或堆叠更深来进行缩放。在这项工作中，我们探索了一条补充路径：分支，即完整 Transformer 块的并行组合。我们引入了多分支变压器（MBT），它通过共享初始层处理输入，并行执行顺序块的独立参数化分支，并在共享最终层之前融合它们的输出。在可比较的训练计算中，我们研究了三种 MBT 变体：Wide-Shallow 保留块宽度，Narrow-Deep 保留顺序深度，以及它们之间的平衡插值。在四种专家混合规模（总参数 0.8B 到 2.1B）的受控预训练实验中，2 分支 Wide-Shallow MBT 在匹配的参数和训练计算预算下始终优于顺序 Transformer。随着分支机构数量的增加，平衡的 MBT 进一步改进并保持可比较的质量。为了提高长上下文的推理效率，我们引入了 Joint-KV，它根据每个深度的分支表示构建共享 KV 缓存。我们的最终方案将平衡 MBT 与联合 KV 结合起来，并由利用分支分组和共享缓存重用的推理引擎支持。拟合的缩放曲线表明，标准 Transformer 需要高达 1.26 倍的训练主体计算量才能匹配我们最终模型的验证损失。这些模型将全模型 KV 缓存存储减少高达 34%，并在单个 H200 GPU 上提供高达 51.4% 的解码吞吐量。消融研究表明，分支产生的收益超出了宽度和深度的变化，实现了有效的 KV 共享策略（Joint-KV），在融合功能之间保持稳健，并且在中间层表现最佳。这些发现表明，分支为扩展语言模型提供了一条实用的途径，以实现更好的建模质量和更快的推理。

papers.title: LoopFill: Pipelined Multi-Token Speculative Decoding for Looped Transformers
papers.summary: Looped Transformers improve parameter efficiency by repeatedly applying the same Transformer layers. During autoregressive decoding, however, generating each token requires several sequential passes through these layers, leading to high decoding latency. Pipelined self-speculative methods use shallow-loop predictions to process tokens at different loops in the same batch, but each token must reach the drafting depth before the next can enter the pipeline. We introduce LoopFill, a training-free speculative decoding algorithm for looped LLM that combines multi-token suffix drafts with shallow-loop predictions in a single draft tree. Both drafters contribute to one tree, so a suffix lookup can immediately extend a shallow prediction and several future tokens can enter the pipeline together. The shared block computes the highest-scoring draft candidates at different loop depths in one batch, and full-depth verification preserves the model's autoregressive output distribution. Across seven benchmarks, LoopFill's average speedup over greedy autoregressive decoding is $5.85\times$ on Ouro-2.6B and $5.13\times$ on Huginn-3.5B. The speedups exceed those of LoopAhead, the strongest baseline, by \(40\%\) on Ouro-2.6B and \(25\%\) on Huginn-3.5B.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且提速显著，但证据完整性待验证
pros: 将浅循环预测与多token后缀草稿统一到单一草稿树，设计有创造性
训练免费且在两种模型七个基准上报告了较大、稳定的解码加速
cons: 摘要未交代统计显著性、硬件配置与代价分解，分布保持与通用性证据仍偏有限

papers.title_zh: LoopF​​ill：循环变压器的流水线多令牌推测解码
papers.summary_zh: 循环 Transformer 通过重复应用相同的 Transformer 层来提高参数效率。然而，在自回归解码期间，生成每个令牌需要多次连续通过这些层，从而导致较高的解码延迟。流水线自推测方法使用浅循环预测来处理同一批次中不同循环的令牌，但每个令牌必须达到绘图深度，然后下一个令牌才能进入管道。我们引入了 LoopF​​ill，这是一种用于循环 LLM 的免训练推测解码算法，它将多令牌后缀草稿与单个草稿树中的浅循环预测相结合。两个起草者都对一棵树做出了贡献，因此后缀查找可以立即扩展浅层预测，并且几个未来的标记可以一起进入管道。共享块计算一批中不同循环深度的得分最高的候选选秀，全深度验证保留了模型的自回归输出分布。在七个基准测试中，LoopF​​ill 相对于贪婪自回归解码的平均加速在 Ouro-2.6B 上为 $5.85\times$，在 Huginn-3.5B 上为 $5.13\times$。加速比在 Ouro-2.6B 上超过了最强基线 LoopAhead 的 \(40\%\)，在 Huginn-3.5B 上超过了 \(25\%\)。

papers.title: Text Speeding Itself Up: Recency and Restraint in Session-Local Drafting
papers.summary: Speculative decoding lets a cheap draft model propose tokens that a large language model verifies in a single forward pass. When the verifier keeps a KV cache, verification is cheap and drafting must be nearly free. Session-local drafters, which predict from the prompt and the text generated so far, meet that bar without training. We compare a recency-weighted, backing-off, confidence-gated session memory against prompt lookup decoding in its reference form, which copies from the earliest earlier match, and in a variant that copies from the most recent one, with paired per-prompt bootstrap intervals throughout. On general, medical, and legal text with a Mistral-7B verifier, recency accounts for the speed: most-recent lookup gains up to 0.09 in speedup over earliest-match lookup on 500-token generations, and session memory's weighting and backoff add nothing measurable on top, at 30 to 40 times the drafting cost. Energy tells a different story. On medical and legal text, unselective drafters are 14% faster than plain decoding yet use as much energy per token, while drafters that abstain on weak evidence save 3 to 4 joules per 100 tokens; a three-token minimum match length on prompt lookup matches the confidence-gated session memory. Outputs are token-identical to greedy decoding in 94% of generations, with every divergence at a numerical near-tie. Under a repetition penalty, long-generation speedups shrink from 1.4-1.7x to 1.1-1.2x, but recency still helps and the length floor is the only drafter that saves energy in both domains.

quality.verdict: 问题切中部署痛点，结论扎实但方法创新有限。
pros: 将recency因素与基线变体严格拆解，因果归因清晰且有统计区间支撑

papers.title_zh: 文本加速：会话本地起草中的新近性和限制
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码让廉价的草稿模型提出令牌，大型语言模型在单次前向传递中验证这些令牌。当验证者保留 KV 缓存时，验证成本很低，并且起草几乎是免费的。会话本地起草者根据提示和迄今为止生成的文本进行预测，无需培训即可达到该标准。我们将新近度加权、回退、置信门控会话内存与参考形式的提示查找解码进行比较，参考形式从最早的较早匹配复制，以及从最近的匹配复制的变体，并在整个过程中具有配对的每个提示引导间隔。在使用 Mistral-7B 验证器的一般、医学和法律文本中，新近度决定了速度：在 500 个令牌代上，最近的查找比最早匹配的查找的加速提高了 0.09，并且会话内存的权重和退避没有增加任何可测量的内容，是起草成本的 30 到 40 倍。能源讲述了一个不同的故事。在医学和法律文本上，无选择性的起草者比普通解码快 14%，但每个标记使用的能量相同，而放弃弱证据的起草者每 100 个标记可节省 3 到 4 焦耳；提示查找时的三个令牌最小匹配长度与置信门控会话内存相匹配。在 94% 的世代中，输出与贪婪解码是相同的，每次分歧都在数值上接近平局。在重复惩罚下，长代加速从 1.4-1.7 倍缩小到 1.1-1.2 倍，但新近度仍然有帮助，并且长度地板是唯一在这两个领域都节省能量的起草者。

papers.title: Architectures and KV Replay for Depth-Recurrent Language Models
papers.summary: Depth recurrence increases effective model depth by repeatedly applying a fixed computation block. However, sharing attention parameters does not share the key-value (KV) states generated at different recurrence iterations, which causes memory growth with recurrence depth during autoregressive decoding. We study how to reduce this memory cost through architectural and cache-sharing approaches within a common depth-recurrent framework. We first study a looped hybrid that repeats a stack of Transformer layers, with recurrent mLSTM or Gated DeltaNet blocks replacing most attention layers and periodic Transformer attention anchors retained. We then restrict recurrence to a dedicated recurrent workspace in a Parcae-style architecture and test its stabilising adapter as a wrapper for the looped hybrid. Finally, we train a looped Transformer with recurrent KV replay, where only selected recurrence iterations write KV states that later iterations reuse. This trains the model to operate with the same shared KV topology used during inference. We find that looped hybrids require sufficiently frequent attention anchors, with performance depending strongly on the recurrent mixer. For cross-iteration KV sharing, recurrent KV replay allows multiple recurrence iterations to reuse the same KV states while retaining performance close to the full looped Transformer with separate KV caches for each iteration.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，方案新颖但证据仍偏初步。
pros: 聚焦深度递归解码中KV缓存随递归深度增长的关键瓶颈，具备明确实用价值
提出“训练-推理一致”的KV replay思路，并在统一框架下比较多种架构路线
cons: 摘要未体现充分的定量结果、统计稳健性与跨任务泛化，难判断收益是否稳定且可复现

papers.title_zh: 深度循环语言模型的架构和 KV 重放
papers.summary_zh: 深度递归通过重复应用固定计算块来增加有效模型深度。然而，共享注意力参数并不共享不同循环迭代时生成的键值（KV）状态，这会导致自回归解码期间内存随着循环深度而增长。我们研究如何通过通用深度循环框架内的架构和缓存共享方法来降低内存成本。我们首先研究一个循环混合体，它重复一堆 Transformer 层，用循环的 mLSTM 或门控 DeltaNet 块取代大多数注意力层，并保留周期性的 Transformer 注意力锚。然后，我们将循环限制在 Parcae 风格架构中的专用循环工作区，并测试其稳定适配器作为循环混合的包装器。最后，我们训练一个具有循环 KV 重播的循环 Transformer，其中只有选定的循环迭代写入稍后迭代重用的 KV 状态。这会训练模型使用推理期间使用的相同共享 KV 拓扑进行操作。我们发现循环混合需要足够频繁的注意力锚，其性能很大程度上取决于循环混合器。对于跨迭代 KV 共享，循环 KV 重放允许多次循环迭代重用相同的 KV 状态，同时保持接近全循环 Transformer 的性能，并且每次迭代都有单独的 KV 缓存。

papers.title: Rethinking KV Caching for LLM Decode: Free-Space Optical KV Regeneration for Reduction of Memory Traffic
papers.summary: Long-context large language model (LLM) decoding repeatedly reads the historical key-value (KV) cache, making multi-head attention (MHA) memory-bandwidth-bound. Caching layer-input activations instead halves historical-cache storage and traffic, but requires regenerating KV from each cached activation. On digital accelerators such as GPUs, this regeneration takes far longer than fetching the activation from HBM. The KV regeneration overhead outweighs the savings from reduced memory traffic, shifting decode attention from a memory bottleneck to a compute bottleneck. We present OptiDecode, a hybrid optoelectronic decode-attention accelerator that regenerates historical KV using free-space optics and computes attention digitally. Projection weights remain resident on optical tiles, exploiting reuse across historical tokens for high-throughput optical regeneration. Scaling to large models introduces two challenges. First, distributing weights across tiles requires sending the same activations to every head group, while each readout die produces only partial KV. Activation replay shares one set of electrical-to-optical converters across head groups without costly broadcast. In-situ attention avoids transferring partial KV from readout dies to reducers by computing on them locally and exchanging only partial scores, probabilities, and partial outputs. Second, processing an activation chunk through all dependent stages takes longer than one activation-fetch interval. Chunk pipelining overlaps successive chunks so that OptiDecode sustains the HBM activation-fetch rate. OptiDecode demonstrates 1.92-1.99x decode-attention speedup over an ideal GPU KV-read baseline at equal peak HBM bandwidth (A100-B200), for 32K-token contexts across evaluated 30B-175B MHA models, approaching the 2x upper bound from halving historical memory traffic.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且潜在影响大，但实证与可落地性待加强。
pros: 抓住KV缓存带宽瓶颈，提出接近2x上界的体系结构目标明确
光电混合设计含激活重放与分块流水，系统协同优化较完整
cons: 结果主要基于理想化等带宽基线，工艺可行性与端到端成本证据不足
缺少对训练/部署复杂度、误差鲁棒性及与替代方案的全面对比

papers.title_zh: 重新思考 LLM 解码的 KV 缓存：自由空间光学 KV 再生以减少内存流量
papers.summary_zh: 长上下文大语言模型 (LLM) 解码会重复读取历史键值 (KV) 缓存，从而导致多头注意力 (MHA) 内存带宽受限。相反，缓存层输入激活会将历史缓存存储和流量减半，但需要从每个缓存的激活中重新生成 KV。在 GPU 等数字加速器上，这种再生所需的时间比从 HBM 获取激活要长得多。 KV 再生开销超过了内存流量减少带来的节省，从而将解码注意力从内存瓶颈转移到计算瓶颈。我们推出了 OptiDecode，一种混合​​光电解码注意力加速器，它使用自由空间光学重新生成历史 KV 并以数字方式计算注意力。投影权重仍然驻留在光学块上，利用历史令牌的重用来实现高吞吐量光学再生。扩展到大型模型会带来两个挑战。首先，在图块之间分配权重需要向每个头组发送相同的激活，而每个读出芯片仅产生部分 KV。激活重播在头组之间共享一组电光转换器，无需昂贵的广播。原位注意力通过在本地计算并仅交换部分分数、概率和部分输出，避免将部分 KV 从读出芯片转移到减速器。其次，通过所有相关阶段处理激活块需要比一个激活获取间隔更长的时间。块流水线与连续块重叠，以便 OptiDecode 维持 HBM 激活获取速率。对于评估的 30B-175B MHA 模型中的 32K 令牌上下文，OptiDecode 展示了在相同峰值 HBM 带宽 (A100-B200) 下，解码注意力加速比理想 GPU KV 读取基线提高了 1.92-1.99 倍，接近历史内存流量减半的 2 倍上限。

papers.title: DynaDFlash: Dynamic Feature Projection for Block Diffusion Speculators
papers.summary: DFlash trains a parallel draft model on hidden features from its target model. Inspired by the previous work of DFlare that introduced per layer combinations of target hidden states, we test whether context dependent weighting of these states helps improve acceptance length of block diffusion speculators. We trained both a DFlash baseline for the Qwen 3 of block size 16, and a dynamic model that computes gates for each layer to affect the magnitude of hidden features before projection. While mean acceptance length between the dynamic model and the DFlash baseline didn't significantly differ, we notice that the dynamic model excels for drafting in the context of math. In an evaluation of 700 prompts from the MetaMathQA and Orca-Math datasets, the mean accepted length improves by 5%. We also found this lead to a 4.1% higher throughput for a subset of the same dataset in the context of speculative decoding.
papers.comment: Code and trained models available at https://github.com/midas-llm-research/DynaDFlash

quality.label: 中等
quality.verdict: 有一定实证价值，但创新与证据力度偏弱。
pros: 聚焦推理效率关键指标，报告了接受长度与吞吐提升
在数学场景给出700条提示评测，显示一定任务特化收益
cons: 总体平均接受长度未显著优于基线，核心方法收益有限
实验范围较窄且缺少统计显著性、方差与消融细节

papers.title_zh: DynaDFlash：块扩散投机者的动态特征投影
papers.summary_zh: DFlash 根据目标模型的隐藏特征训练并行草稿模型。受到 DFlare 之前引入目标隐藏状态的每层组合的启发，我们测试了这些状态的上下文相关权重是否有助于提高块扩散推测器的接受长度。我们训练了块大小为 16 的 Qwen 3 的 DFlash 基线，以及计算每层门以影响投影前隐藏特征大小的动态模型。虽然动态模型和 DFlash 基线之间的平均接受长度没有显着差异，但我们注意到动态模型在数学背景下擅长绘图。在对来自 MetaMathQA 和 Orca-Math 数据集的 700 个提示的评估中，平均接受长度提高了 5%。我们还发现，在推测解码的情况下，同一数据集的子集的吞吐量提高了 4.1%。

papers.title: NVFP4-MLA: Unified FP4 KV-Cache Storage and Attention Computation for Multi-Head Latent Attention
papers.summary: Long-context reasoning and agentic workloads make key-value (KV) cache capacity and attention computation the dominant costs of serving frontier large language models. We present NVFP4-MLA, the first design to push both KV-cache storage and attention computation of multi-head latent attention (MLA) to FP4. NVFP4-MLA co-designs the quantization algorithm with the attention kernel and the cache system. Selective residual compensation preserves model accuracy by adding NVFP4 residuals only to the quantization-sensitive channels. Two-dimensional quantization blocks make the shared latent cache compatible with the different reduction directions of the two attention batched matrix multiplications (BMMs), removing requantization between them. On DeepSeek-R1 and Kimi-K3, NVFP4-MLA matches BF16 MLA average accuracy across nine benchmarks while compressing the MLA KV cache by 3.20x and 3.05x relative to BF16 MLA. On NVIDIA Rubin GPUs, NVFP4-MLA speeds up the attention kernel over FP8 MLA by up to 2.82x on DeepSeek-R1 and 2.71x on Kimi-K3, and lowers p90 time to first token in agentic multi-turn serving by up to 3.5x and 2.1x, respectively. In disaggregated DeepSeek-R1 serving, it also raises per-GPU throughput by up to 2.30x.

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 工程价值高，但证据完整性仍待加强。
pros: 将MLA的KV存储与注意力计算统一推进到FP4，系统与算法协同设计有新意
在长上下文与多轮服务场景给出显著时延与吞吐收益，实用意义强
cons: 摘要缺少误差来源分解、消融细节与跨硬件泛化证据，严谨性与可复现性风险仍在

papers.title_zh: NVFP4-MLA：用于多头潜在注意力的统一 FP4 KV 缓存存储和注意力计算
papers.summary_zh: 长上下文推理和代理工作负载使键值 (KV) 缓存容量和注意力计算成为服务前沿大型语言模型的主要成本。我们提出了 NVFP4-MLA，这是第一个将 KV 缓存存储和多头潜在注意力 (MLA) 注意力计算推向 FP4 的设计。 NVFP4-MLA与注意力内核和缓存系统共同设计了量化算法。选择性残差补偿通过仅将 NVFP4 残差添加到量化敏感通道来保持模型精度。二维量化块使共享潜在缓存与两个注意力批量矩阵乘法（BMM）的不同缩减方向兼容，从而消除了它们之间的重新量化。在 DeepSeek-R1 和 Kimi-K3 上，NVFP4-MLA 在九个基准测试中与 BF16 MLA 平均精度相匹配，同时将 MLA KV 缓存相对于 BF16 MLA 压缩了 3.20 倍和 3.05 倍。在 NVIDIA Rubin GPU 上，NVFP4-MLA 在 DeepSeek-R1 上将注意力内核的速度比 FP8 MLA 提高了 2.82 倍，在 Kimi-K3 上提高了 2.71 倍，并将代理多轮服务中的第一个令牌的 p90 时间分别缩短了 3.5 倍和 2.1 倍。在分解的 DeepSeek-R1 服务中，它还将每个 GPU 的吞吐量提高了 2.30 倍。

papers.title: SpecRelay: Amortize or Avoid the Round Trip in Edge-Cloud Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: Edge-cloud speculative decoding moves autoregressive drafting to an edge device while a larger cloud model verifies draft tokens in parallel, so that edge drafting and cloud verification overlap under a synchronous draft-verify schedule. Beyond low-latency local networks, however, the next verification request of that schedule can be sent only after the previous reply arrives, so every round still waits out a full round trip, and throughput falls as the network RTT grows. To recover this loss, we present SpecRelay, an edge-cloud LLM inference system that addresses this cost at two levels: it amortizes round trips when cloud verification is necessary and avoids them when local reasoning suffices. For cloud-bound queries, an asynchronous verification pipeline keeps fixed-budget draft trees in flight while earlier replies are still outstanding, and the cloud rejects stale requests before the target-model forward pass (the asynchronous schedule). At the query level, an RTT-conditioned router (the Latency-Aware Router) estimates quality and completion latency for three on-device modes (direct generation, Chain-of-Draft, and full reasoning) and cloud speculative decoding, selecting among them under a configurable accuracy-latency objective without adding latency during inference, since the router runs concurrently with the draft-model prefill. The asynchronous schedule alone improves decoding throughput by up to 50% over a reproduced synchronous baseline across multiple benchmarks. At matched target-model accuracy and 250 ms of added round-trip latency, the full system with the router delivers 1.95x and 1.55x the throughput of the same baseline on SPROUT and OlympiadBench, respectively, while sending only 47% and 39% of the queries to the cloud.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，方案实用且效果亮眼。
pros: 准确抓住高RTT下同步推测解码的核心瓶颈，系统动机充分
异步验证与延迟感知路由形成跨层协同，兼顾吞吐与云端成本
给出多基准与高延迟场景增益，且报告云请求占比下降，实用价值高
cons: 摘要未充分说明统计显著性、置信区间及复现实验细节，严谨性证据仍偏弱
路由器质量预测误差与分布外稳健性风险未交代，可能影响泛化

papers.title_zh: SpecRelay：分摊或避免边缘云推测解码中的往返
papers.summary_zh: 边缘云推测解码将自回归起草移动到边缘设备，而更大的云模型并行验证草稿令牌，以便边缘起草和云验证在同步草稿验证计划下重叠。然而，除了低延迟本地网络之外，该计划的下一个验证请求只能在前一个回复到达后才能发送，因此每一轮仍然等待完整的往返，并且吞吐量随着网络 RTT 的增长而下降。为了弥补这种损失，我们推出了 SpecRelay，这是一种边缘云 LLM 推理系统，它在两个层面上解决了这一成本：当需要云验证时，它分摊往返次数；当本地推理足够时，它会避免往返次数。对于云绑定查询，异步验证管道使固定预算草稿树保持运行状态，而早期答复仍然未完成，并且云在目标模型前向传递（异步计划）之前拒绝过时的请求。在查询级别，RTT 调节的路由器（延迟感知路由器）估计三种设备上模式（直接生成、草稿链和完整推理）和云推测解码的质量和完成延迟，在可配置的准确性延迟目标下进行选择，而不会在推理期间增加延迟，因为路由器与草稿模型预填充同时运行。与多个基准测试中再现的同步基线相比，仅异步调度即可将解码吞吐量提高高达 50%。在匹配目标模型精度和增加 250 毫秒的往返延迟的情况下，带有路由器的完整系统在 SPROUT 和 OlympiadBench 上的相同基准上分别提供 1.95 倍和 1.55 倍的吞吐量，同时仅将 47% 和 39% 的查询发送到云。

papers.title: Exstill: The Most Efficient Single-Chip Processor for the Next Token
papers.summary: Generating a token with a language model requires a fixed amount of arithmetic, whose energy sets a floor beneath any hardware. For Qwen3-1.7B at a 16K-token context, gate-level measurements at 5 nm place this floor at 0.89 mJ per token, yet an NVIDIA B300 spends 391-1,120x that. The excess is the price of generality, software layers, programmable hardware and moving weights and key-value (KV) caches from external memory, and it widens with each process generation. We present a co-design approach that brings token generation close to this floor and then lowers the floor itself, optimizing silicon and model together in a gate-level search loop. Fixing one model architecture in the datapath, with weights still loadable, and holding weights and every conversation's KV cache on-die, a pre-silicon 5 nm design brings an unchanged Qwen3-1.7B token to 3.4x its floor. Co-designing the model with the circuits at fixed quality lowers the floor to 0.29 mJ and the token to 0.52 mJ, 1.8x the new floor and less than the baseline model's arithmetic alone, while on-die capacity grows from one user to twelve. Against a measured B300 serving the same twelve users, the design decodes each user's tokens 110x faster at 690x lower energy. To show that one fixed architecture can serve, as a co-processor, the latency-critical workloads around a frontier model, we introduce Polyglot-DC (1.7B and 4B, each with its own design), specialized for each job by distillation and task-specific training into its own weights. As a drafter it speeds single-user speculative decoding of large open models by up to 6.6x at the maximum reasoning effort. Its guard returns multilingual verdicts in a millisecond or less, within a point of the strongest open guard. Its agent and financial-reasoning models lead comparable open models on established benchmarks, with a reasoning turn falling from seconds to tens of milliseconds.
papers.comment: 62 pages plus references (72 total), 16 figures, 22 tables. Technical report

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 目标宏大且结果惊艳，但证据链仍待补强。
pros: 提出“算术能耗下界+门级协同搜索”的软硬件共设计算法，方向新颖
在单芯片驻留权重与KV并面向多任务协处理器的系统叙事中展现出高潜在影响力
cons: 核心结论多基于5nm预硅与特定模型，跨工艺、跨模型、真实部署可复现性不明
与B300的对比可能受软件栈与优化程度影响，公平性与可比性需更透明披露

papers.title_zh: Exstill：下一代代币最高效的单芯片处理器
papers.summary_zh: 使用语言模型生成令牌需要固定数量的算术，其能量为任何硬件奠定了基础。对于 16K 令牌上下文中的 Qwen3-1.7B，5 nm 处的门级测量使该下限为每个令牌 0.89 mJ，而 ​​NVIDIA B300 的花费是该数字的 391-1,120 倍。多余的部分是通用性、软件层、可编程硬件以及来自外部存储器的移动权重和键值 (KV) 缓存的价格，并且随着每一代进程的产生而扩大。我们提出了一种协同设计方法，使代币生成接近该层，然后降低该层本身，在门级搜索循环中一起优化芯片和模型。在数据路径中修复一个模型架构，权重仍然可加载，并在芯片上保存权重和每个会话的 KV 缓存，硅前 5 nm 设计将未更改的 Qwen3-1.7B 令牌提升至 3.4 倍。与固定质量的电路共同设计模型可将下限降低至 0.29 mJ，并将代币降低至 0.52 mJ，是新下限的 1.8 倍，并且低于基线模型单独的算术，同时片上容量从 1 个用户增加到 12 个。与服务于相同 12 个用户的 B300 测量结果相比，该设计对每个用户的令牌的解码速度提高了 110 倍，能耗降低了 690 倍。为了证明一个固定架构可以作为协处理器，服务于前沿模型周围的延迟关键型工作负载，我们引入了 Polyglot-DC（1.7B 和 4B，每个都有自己的设计），通过蒸馏和特定于任务的训练到自己的权重来专门针对每项工作。作为起草者，它在最大推理努力下将大型开放模型的单用户推测解码速度提高了 6.6 倍。它的警卫可以在一毫秒或更短的时间内返回多语言判决，与最强的开放警卫相差不远。其代理和金融推理模型在既定基准上领先于同类开放模型，推理时间从几秒降至几十毫秒。

papers.title: Callo: Serving Cache-Miss Requests with Speculative Decoding on Invalidated KV under Prefill-Decode Disaggregation
papers.summary: Agent sessions may involve frequent context edits, which effectively invalidate cached KV state and force requests to wait for re-prefill before decoding. We present Callo, a disaggregated serving system that leverages invalidated KV for speculative drafts to reduce this latency, while verifying drafts against the exact KV after prefill before committing tokens. Callo makes effective use of decode resources by scheduling speculations during periods of underutilization and preempting speculations when drafts are likely to not be accepted. We evaluated Callo on a two-GPU testbed using SWE-agent sessions across three model families, observing all-request speedups of 1.05-1.19x over vLLM at moderate load. We demonstrate that these gains are also realized at scale through cluster-level simulations driven by real-world traces.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且实用，但实证广度与严谨性仍不足。
pros: 抓住KV失效导致重prefill延迟的关键痛点，问题设定贴近Agent真实负载
将失效KV用于投机草稿并在精确KV上验证，结合调度与抢占机制，系统设计完整
cons: 主要结果基于两卡测试床与仿真，真实大规模线上验证、误接收代价与稳定性分析仍不充分
相对vLLM的总体加速幅度中等（1.05-1.19x），在高负载或不同工作负载下收益边界不够清晰

papers.title_zh: Callo：在预填充解码分解下对无效 KV 进行推测解码，为缓存未命中请求提供服务
papers.summary_zh: 代理会话可能涉及频繁的上下文编辑，这会有效地使缓存的 KV 状态无效并强制请求在解码之前等待重新预填充。我们提出了 Callo，一个分解的服务系统，它利用无效的 KV 进行推测性草稿来减少这种延迟，同时在提交代币之前预填充后根据确切的 KV 验证草稿。 Callo 通过在未充分利用期间安排猜测并在草稿可能不被接受时抢先进行猜测，从而有效地利用解码资源。我们在两个 GPU 测试台上使用跨三个模型系列的 SWE 代理会话对 Callo 进行了评估，观察到在中等负载下所有请求的加速比 vLLM 提高了 1.05-1.19 倍。我们证明，这些收益也可以通过由现实世界痕迹驱动的集群级模拟来大规模实现。

papers.title: More Genes, Faster Inference: Efficient Large-Panel Spatial Transcriptomics Prediction from Histology
papers.summary: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) prediction from histology aims to infer spatially resolved gene expression profiles directly from tissue images. This is a challenging problem that is currently often addressed with complicated model architectures, additional inputs, and complicated training procedures, while remaining limited to fixed, small gene panels. This raises a natural question: Is there an efficient method for large-panel ST prediction? Here, we present GeneFlow, a simpler yet effective framework for large-scale spatial gene expression prediction that unifies flow-matching generative modeling with structured multimodal fusion. Specifically, GeneFlow first encodes both histological morphology and cross-gene interactions in spatial spots through histology and gene tokenizers. The model directly predicts spatial gene expression, rather than an intermediate velocity field, while being trained with a velocity-based flow-matching objective. We show that, even without relying on heavy generative pipelines, GeneFlow achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple ST benchmarks, with up to 56.8% gains in 1,000-gene prediction. Extensive experiments further show that GeneFlow produces biologically meaningful spot profiles while reducing computational cost by orders of magnitude, thereby improving efficiency and scalability, particularly in clinical settings. We believe GeneFlow provides an opportunity for leveraging widely available histology images for downstream biological discovery. Code is available at: https://github.com/ZZhangsm/GeneFlow

papers.title_zh: 更多基因，更快推理：根据组织学进行高效的大面板空间转录组学预测
papers.summary_zh: 组织学的空间转录组学 (ST) 预测旨在直接从组织图像推断空间解析的基因表达谱。这是一个具有挑战性的问题，目前通常通过复杂的模型架构、额外的输入和复杂的训练程序来解决，同时仍然局限于固定的小型基因组。这就提出了一个自然的问题：是否有一种有效的大面板 ST 预测方法？在这里，我们提出了 GeneFlow，一个更简单但有效的大规模空间基因表达预测框架，它将流匹配生成模型与结构化多模态融合结合起来。具体来说，GeneFlow 首先通过组织学和基因标记器对空间点的组织学形态和跨基因相互作用进行编码。该模型直接预测空间基因表达，而不是中间速度场，同时使用基于速度的流匹配目标进行训练。我们表明，即使不依赖大量的生成管道，GeneFlow 也能在多个 ST 基准测试中实现最先进的性能，在 1,000 个基因预测中提升高达 56.8%。大量实验进一步表明，GeneFlow 可以生成具有生物学意义的点图谱，同时将计算成本降低几个数量级，从而提高效率和可扩展性，特别是在临床环境中。我们相信 GeneFlow 为利用广泛可用的组织学图像进行下游生物学发现提供了机会。代码位于：https://github.com/ZZhangsm/GeneFlow

papers.title: Broadcast, Don't Replicate: Eliminating Weight HBM in Datacenter LLM Serving
papers.summary: Large language model (LLM) inference at datacenter scale is fundamentally bottlenecked by memory capacity and bandwidth limits. Because model weights are read-only and identical across instances, conventional architectures that replicate these parameters across the local DRAM of tens of thousands of accelerators incur massive capital expenditures, significant static power dissipation, and redundant memory-fetch energy. A recent proposal to use optical fiber loops as delay-line memory alleviates these issues, but its recirculating loop must hold the whole model: loop length grows with model size, slack is fixed when the ring is built, and the layouts that serve modern Mixture of Experts (MoE) models efficiently do not fit in it. We propose Optical Broadcast Memory (OBM), an open-ended hierarchical Tap-and-Amplify fiber architecture that generalizes and replaces the optical ring paradigm. A centralized memory server continuously broadcasts weights to distributed inference nodes that passively tap the data stream using receive-only co-packaged optics, delivering parameters directly to compute units without intermediate buffering. To overcome the limitations of continuous weight streaming, we use dynamically-sized slack to accommodate large and variable context lengths. We show how removing the restrictions of the optical ring allows OBM to efficiently serve MoE models. Evaluated at a datacenter scale of 80,000 accelerators, OBM eliminates petabytes of HBM while being competitive or better in throughput and energy per token than an HBM-based system.

papers.title_zh: 广播，不复制：消除数据中心 LLM 服务中的权重 HBM
papers.summary_zh: 数据中心规模的大型语言模型 (LLM) 推理从根本上受到内存容量和带宽限制的瓶颈。由于模型权重是只读的并且在实例之间是相同的，因此在数万个加速器的本地 DRAM 上复制这些参数的传统架构会产生大量的资本支出、显着的静态功耗和冗余的内存获取能量。最近提出的使用光纤环路作为延迟线存储器的建议缓解了这些问题，但其循环环路必须容纳整个模型：环路长度随着模型大小而增长，环路构建时松弛度是固定的，而有效服务于现代专家混合 (MoE) 模型的布局并不适合它。我们提出了光学广播存储器（OBM），这是一种开放式分层分接放大光纤架构，可推广并取代光学环范式。集中式内存服务器不断地将权重广播到分布式推理节点，这些节点使用仅接收的共同封装光学器件被动地挖掘数据流，将参数直接传递到计算单元，无需中间缓冲。为了克服连续权重流的限制，我们使用动态大小的松弛来适应大且可变的上下文长度。我们展示了如何消除光学环的限制使 OBM 能够有效地为 MoE 模型提供服务。在 80,000 个加速器的数据中心规模上进行评估，OBM 消除了 PB 级的 HBM，同时与基于 HBM 的系统相比，在吞吐量和每代币能量方面具有竞争力或更好。

papers.title: Towards Green Text Generation: Memory-Based Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: Speculative decoding accelerates text generation with large language models by letting a cheap draft model propose tokens that a large verifier checks in a single forward pass. We introduce Olifant, a draft model built on a memory-based classifier. It predicts the next token from a four-token window in under 0.3 ms on CPU, requiring no GPU, no backpropagation, and no accelerator memory. We measure throughput and energy under two verifier regimes on consumer hardware. Without a KV cache, drafting is nearly free: a domain-matched Olifant model reaches 38.1% acceptance on EU legal text, delivering 2.43x throughput and 2.51x lower energy per token than the neural verifier model alone. With a KV-cached verifier, itself a ~10x energy saver, drafting costs matter: a TinyLlama draft model halves throughput and triples energy despite high acceptance, whereas Olifant still yields 1.25x throughput and the lowest energy in the study (93 J per 100 tokens, 14x below the uncached baseline). We further show that KV caching decouples time from energy: verification of longer drafts raises power draw, shifting the energy-optimal draft length below the speed-optimal one. Speculative decoding is not dead in the age of fast verifiers, provided drafting is nearly free.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables. Published at the 19th International Natural Language Generation Conference (INLG 2026). Code: https://github.com/antalvdb/olifant-speculative ; models: https://huggingface.co/antalvdb/olifant-speculative-ibases
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 19th International Natural Language Generation Conference: Long Papers, pages 472-482, October 2026

papers.title_zh: 迈向绿色文本生成：基于内存的推测解码
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码通过让廉价的草稿模型提出大型验证者在单次前向传递中检查的标记，从而加速大型语言模型的文本生成。我们介绍 Olifant，一个基于内存分类器构建的草案模型。它可以在 CPU 上的 0.3 毫秒内从四个令牌窗口中预测下一个令牌，不需要 GPU、不需要反向传播，也不需要加速器内存。我们在消费类硬件上的两种验证器机制下测量吞吐量和能量。如果没有 KV 缓存，起草几乎是免费的：域匹配的 Olifant 模型在欧盟法律文本上的接受度达到 38.1%，与单独的神经验证器模型相比，吞吐量提高了 2.43 倍，每个令牌的能量降低了 2.51 倍。使用 KV 缓存验证器（本身节能约 10 倍），起草成本很重要：尽管接受度较高，TinyLlama 草案模型的吞吐量却减半，能源增加三倍，而 Olifant 仍产生 1.25 倍的吞吐量和研究中最低的能源（每 100 个令牌 93 J，比未缓存基线低 14 倍）。我们进一步表明，KV 缓存将时间与能量解耦：较长草稿的验证会增加功耗，将能量最佳草稿长度移至速度最佳草稿长度以下。在快速验证器时代，推测性解码并没有消亡，只要起草几乎是免费的。

papers.title: HeMeR: Heterogeneous Memory Reconciliation for Embodied Agents via Structured KV Reuse
papers.summary: Embodied agents make decisions by combining information from heterogeneous memory modules, including declarative memory for explicit knowledge, procedural memory for learned routines, and working memory for current observations. During interaction, the memory contents required for decision making change with the agent's state, goal, and task progress, while many contents remain shared across consecutive decisions. However, existing memory modules are typically accessed through separate interfaces, so each updated memory context is often processed as a new input to the foundation model. This prevents selective key-value (KV) cache reuse for unchanged memory contents and forces full KV cache recomputation even when much of the memory context remains valid. We introduce HeMeR, an inference framework that performs KV reconciliation between dynamically updated memory contexts and reusable KV states. HeMeR tracks declarative, procedural, and working memory contents across action decisions, preserves KV states for unchanged contents, and reconciles only the KV states affected by memory-content updates. This enables efficient and stable inference as memory contents evolve during interaction. We evaluate HeMeR on ALFWorld, Habitat, and real-world robotic deployments requiring coordinated use of heterogeneous memory contents. In the real-world setting, HeMeR achieves 83.20% task success and reduces per-step inference time from 2.94 to 1.87 seconds compared with MemRL, while preserving compatible KV states as task progress updates the memory context.

papers.title_zh: HeMeR：通过结构化 KV 重用实现实体代理的异构内存协调
papers.summary_zh: 具身智能体通过组合来自异构记忆模块的信息来做出决策，包括用于显性知识的陈述性记忆、用于学习例程的程序性记忆以及用于当前观察的工作记忆。在交互过程中，决策所需的记忆内容会随着智能体的状态、目标和任务进度而变化，而许多内容在连续的决策中仍然是共享的。然而，现有的内存模块通常是通过单独的接口访问的，因此每个更新的内存上下文通常被处理为基础模型的新输入。这可以防止对未更改的内存内容进行选择性键值 (KV) 缓存重用，并强制完全 KV 缓存重新计算，即使大部分内存上下文仍然有效。我们引入了 HeMeR，一个推理框架，它在动态更新的内存上下文和可重用的 KV 状态之间执行 KV 协调。 HeMeR 跟踪动作决策中的声明性、程序性和工作记忆内容，保留未更改内容的 KV 状态，并且仅协调受记忆内容更新影响的 KV 状态。随着交互过程中记忆内容的演变，这可以实现高效、稳定的推理。我们在 ALFWorld、Habitat 和需要协调使用异构内存内容的现实世界机器人部署上评估 HeMeR。在现实环境中，与 MemRL 相比，HeMeR 实现了 83.20% 的任务成功率，并将每步推理时间从 2.94 秒减少到 1.87 秒，同时在任务进度更新内存上下文时保留兼容的 KV 状态。

papers.title: FPSRG: Heterogeneous User Simulation First-Person Post-Training and Multidimensional Semantic Response Grids
papers.summary: Simulating heterogeneous individuals with large language models is an active research direction, and heterogeneous user simulation requires models with different characteristics. We study profile construction: given dimensions, items, and scoring rules, build model configurations that can be retrieved by multidimensional target scores. We introduce First-Person Semantic Response Grids (FPSRG). Shared post-training first teaches the model to judge and answer as the participant; self-report and behavioral targets then refine dimension-specific control vectors. With the model frozen, we measure joint scores for vector-coefficient combinations, filter inadmissible configurations, and store the results in a searchable catalog. Per-token configuration routing, continuous batching, and isolated caches support parallel measurement of different profiles. Non-thinking five- and ten-dimensional Qwen instances and a thinking-mode six-dimensional instance following full-parameter post-training of Huihui demonstrate the complete workflow. With matched data, layers, and norms, refinement increases mean five-axis composite control span from 30.75 to 40.45. Within the five-dimensional 25-75 target region, the qualified five-level vector catalog covers 92.2% of fixed targets under per-axis error at most 20 and total error at most 60; combining it with the prompt catalog increases coverage to 98.7%. At a fixed coefficient range, three-, five-, and nine-level catalogs achieve 71.2%, 92.2%, and 94.6% coverage, demonstrating the gains from denser measurement. These results describe measured reachable regions under a fixed assessment protocol. Through shared adaptation, a small set of learned directions, and reusable joint measurements, FPSRG constructs heterogeneous individual configurations without retraining a model for every profile.

papers.title_zh: FPSRG：异构用户模拟第一人称训练后和多维语义响应网格
papers.summary_zh: 用大型语言模型模拟异构个体是一个活跃的研究方向，异构用户模拟需要具有不同特征的模型。我们研究档案构建：给定维度、项目和评分规则，构建可以通过多维目标分数检索的模型配置。我们引入第一人称语义响应网格（FPSRG）。共享后训练首先教会模型作为参与者进行判断和回答；自我报告和行为目标然后细化特定维度的控制向量。模型冻结后，我们测量向量系数组合的联合分数，过滤不允许的配置，并将结果存储在可搜索的目录中。每个令牌配置路由、连续批处理和隔离缓存支持不同配置文件的并行测量。慧慧全参数后训练后的非思维五维、十维Qwen实例和思维模式六维实例展示了完整的工作流程。通过匹配数据、图层和规范，细化将平均五轴复合控制跨度从 30.75 增加到 40.45。在五维25-75目标区域内，合格的五级矢量目录覆盖了92.2%的固定目标，每轴误差不超过20，总误差不超过60；与提示目录相结合可将覆盖率提高到 98.7%。在固定系数范围内，三级、五级和九级目录的覆盖率分别为 71.2%、92.2% 和 94.6%，展示了更密集测量带来的收益。这些结果描述了在固定评估协议下测量的可到达区域。通过共享适应、一小组学习方向和可重复使用的联合测量，FPSRG 构建异构的单独配置，而无需为每个配置文件重新训练模型。

papers.title: KVPath: Connecting Key-Value Representations Across Transformer Layers
papers.summary: Transformers typically cache an independent key-value (KV) representation for each token at every layer. Recent work reveals that a token's KV representations across neighboring layers are correlated and contain shared information. We hypothesize that this correlation implies incremental inter-layer changes, which can be effectively captured by low-dimensional deltas. Motivated by this, we propose KVPath, a new KV representation paradigm that connects KV representations across the network depth into a path. The path establishes a full-dimensional base KV at the first layer, while subsequent layers generate low-dimensional delta KVs to update the preceding KV, thereby constructing their own KV states. By caching the base KV once alongside these compact delta KVs, KVPath preserves distinct layer-specific representations without storing full KV states at every layer. We develop two variants of KVPath: KVPath-Residual, which updates vector values via residual addition, and KVPath-Rolling, which progressively updates feature dimensions in a rolling manner. Under matched parameter counts, KVPath reduces KV-cache storage by up to 68\% for Grouped-Query Attention (GQA) and 55\% for Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA), while maintaining or even improving model performance.

papers.title_zh: KVPath：跨 Transformer 层连接键值表示
papers.summary_zh: Transformer 通常会在每一层为每个 token 缓存一个独立的键值 (KV) 表示。最近的工作表明，相邻层之间令牌的 KV 表示是相关的，并且包含共享信息。我们假设这种相关性意味着增量的层间变化，可以通过低维增量有效捕获。受此启发，我们提出了 KVPath，一种新的 KV 表示范式，它将跨网络深度的 KV 表示连接成一条路径。该路径在第一层建立全维基础 KV，而后续层生成低维 delta KV 来更新前面的 KV，从而构造自己的 KV 状态。通过将基本 KV 与这些紧凑的增量 KV 一起缓存一次，KVPath 保留了不同的特定于层的表示，而无需在每一层存储完整的 KV 状态。我们开发了 KVPath 的两种变体：KVPath-Residual，它通过残差加法更新向量值；KVPath-Rolling，它以滚动方式逐步更新特征维度。在匹配的参数计数下，KVPath 将分组查询注意力 (GQA) 的 KV 缓存存储减少高达 68%，将多头潜在注意力 (MLA) 减少 55%，同时保持甚至提高模型性能。

papers.title: Frame First, Decode Once: Object-Centric Coordinates and Single-Pass Decoding for System-1 World Models
papers.summary: Single-pass primitive decoders such as LocateAnything and VFlash predict all quantized coordinate tokens of a geometric primitive in one forward pass, enabling fast, System-1 visual planning. We study what matters when such a decoder serves as a System-1 world model: a fast action-conditioned predictor that ranks candidate pushes by their predicted outcome. On ManiSkill3 PushT-v1 (512 held-out test families, 8,192 rollouts) and on human demonstrations from lerobot/pusht (2,384 test windows), we compare decoders, training losses, rigid-body projections and coordinate frames, using matched checkpoints, hierarchical bootstrap confidence intervals and Holm correction. Two factors of similar size dominate. First, expressing inputs and outputs in the SE(2) frame of the object's initial pose lowers decision regret by 1.9-2.2x for each of five decoders, and the object-frame model trained on 128 families matches the world-frame model trained on 512. Second, single-pass decoding outperforms iterative decoding: in the object frame, single-pass heads reach 0.020-0.021 regret at 1.6-1.8 ms per decision, against 0.046 for 10-step DDIM diffusion and 0.059 for KV-cached autoregression at 10.3 and 12.9 ms. The choice among single-pass heads has no measurable effect on regret, and our registered hypothesis that the frame effect exceeds the decoder spread is not supported. Soft-token expectation with an end-to-end 2D Kabsch projection gives the lowest trajectory error (11.35 px on ManiSkill3, 3.78 px on lerobot/pusht), exact rigid-body consistency, and lower regret than diffusion at every budget from 4 to 50 DDIM steps, at 3-29x lower latency.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 6 figures, 7 tables. Code, frozen configurations and per-seed results will be released

papers.title_zh: 先帧，解码一次：System-1 世界模型的以对象为中心的坐标和单通道解码
papers.summary_zh: LocateAnything 和 VFlash 等单通道基元解码器可在一次前向传递中预测几何基元的所有量化坐标标记，从而实现快速的 System-1 视觉规划。我们研究当这样的解码器充当 System-1 世界模型时，什么是重要的：一个快速的动作条件预测器，根据预测结果对候选推送进行排名。在 ManiSkill3 PushT-v1（512 个保留测试系列，8,192 次部署）和来自 lerobot/pusht（2,384 个测试窗口）的人体演示中，我们使用匹配的检查点、分层引导置信区间和 Holm 校正来比较解码器、训练损失、刚体投影和坐标系。两个大小相似的因素占主导地位。首先，在对象初始姿势的 SE(2) 框架中表达输入和输出，可以将 5 个解码器中的每一个的决策遗憾降低 1.9-2.2 倍，并且在 128 个族上训练的对象框架模型与在 512 个族上训练的世界框架模型相匹配。其次，单通道解码优于迭代解码：在对象框架中，单通道头在每 1.6-1.8 毫秒时达到 0.020-0.021 个后悔。决策，10 步 DDIM 扩散为 0.046，KV 缓存自回归在 10.3 和 12.9 毫秒时为 0.059。单通道头之间的选择对遗憾没有可测量的影响，并且我们注册的帧效应超过解码器扩展的假设不受支持。具有端到端 2D Kabsch 投影的软代币期望可提供最低的轨迹误差（ManiSkill3 上为 11.35 px，lerobot/pusht 上为 3.78 px）、精确的刚体一致性，以及在每个预算（从 4 到 50 DDIM 步骤）中比扩散更低的遗憾，延迟降低 3-29 倍。

papers.title: TraceKV: Policy-Preserving Low-Rank KV Cache Compression for Reasoning Vision-Language Models
papers.summary: Reasoning vision-language models (VLMs) impose substantial KV cache demands from both large multimodal contexts and growing reasoning traces. Low-rank KV compression has emerged as a promising paradigm that stores low-dimensional latents of KV states and can be combined with quantization. However, existing low-rank methods often induce growing predictive policy drift from the dense model when compressing reasoning KV states, resulting in reasoning failures. We identify two key causes of this degradation: calibration-state mismatch between static contexts and on-policy reasoning states, and unequal error sensitivity across KV states. To address these challenges, we propose TraceKV, a training-free low-rank KV compression framework that unifies on-policy calibration, sensitivity-aware SVD, and global rank allocation under a single policy-preserving principle, substantially reducing policy-KL divergence during reasoning. Experiments across multiple VLMs and visual reasoning benchmarks demonstrate superior accuracy--memory trade-offs, achieving near-lossless reasoning accuracy with 5.64$\times$ KV cache compression when combined with quantization. Optimized low-rank attention kernels further deliver up to 1.83$\times$ end-to-end decoding speedup. Code will be available at https://github.com/AK-DREAM/TraceKV.
